[SWS_CM_00256] Default data type for the length field of structs
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00201, RS_CM_00202, RS_CM_00211
⌈
If
TransformationPropsToServiceInterfaceElementMapping
.
transfor-
mationProps
.
sizeOfStructLengthField
defines the data type for the length
field of a struct, the data shall be:
•
std::uint8
if
sizeOfStructLengthField
equals 1
•
std::uint16
if
sizeOfStructLengthField
equals 2
•
std::uint32
if
sizeOfStructLengthField
equals 4
